eu5ab_location_combined_pop_promotion_speed = {
	value = modifier:local_pop_promotion_speed
	owner = { add = modifier:global_pop_promotion_speed }
	add = {
		value = modifier:local_pop_promotion_speed_scaled
		multiply = population
	}
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		owner = { add = modifier:global_pop_promotion_speed_modifier }
		add = modifier:local_pop_promotion_speed_modifier
	}
}

# Vanilla rgo_level adds a fixed workforce demand to every raw material.
# Laborers always qualify; unemployed slaves count only when the owner
# has the vanilla country modifier that lets slaves work RGOs.
eu5ab_rgo_jobs_per_expansion = {
	value = 1
}

eu5ab_rgo_current_available_workers = {
	value = "unemployed_pops_of_pop_type_in_location(pop_type:laborers)"
	subtract = eu5ab_queued_jobs_laborers
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { modifier:allow_rgo_slave_demand = yes } }
		add = "unemployed_pops_of_pop_type_in_location(pop_type:slaves)"
		subtract = eu5ab_queued_jobs_slaves
		# The shared RGO reservation is included in both eligible pop pools.
		add = eu5ab_rgo_queued_jobs
	}
}

eu5ab_rgo_promotion_source_pool = {
	value = 0
	add = "unemployed_pops_of_pop_type_in_location(pop_type:peasants)"
}

eu5ab_rgo_projected_promotion = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_rgo_population_mode = yes }
		value = eu5ab_location_combined_pop_promotion_speed
		multiply = 1.5
		multiply = owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_rgo_job_fill_deadline_months
		min = 0
		max = eu5ab_rgo_promotion_source_pool
	}
}

eu5ab_rgo_projected_available_workers = {
	value = eu5ab_rgo_current_available_workers
	add = eu5ab_rgo_projected_promotion
}

eu5ab_recipe_economic_efficiency_score = { value = 0
        if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { eu5ab_quote_context_current = yes
            AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_cost trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_cost } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_quote_cost target = prev } } } }
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_cached_quote_cost > 0 }
            value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_adjusted_profit
            divide = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_cached_quote_cost multiply = 10
        }
    }

# Location scope. Native food_consumption is an engine value, not a per-capita guess.
# Same market as the former GUI read: the province capital, not this location.
eu5ab_location_food_price = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { eu5ab_location_food_price_known = yes }
		value = province.capital.market.food_price
	}
}
eu5ab_location_food_consumption = {
	value = food_consumption
	multiply = -1
	min = food_consumption
}
eu5ab_province_food_reserve_target = {
	value = 0
	province = { every_location_in_province = { add = eu5ab_location_food_consumption } }
	multiply = 6
}
# Native GetRawMaterialsOutput: employed base * max(0, 1 + these four modifiers).
eu5ab_windmill_output_factor = {
	value = 1
	add = modifier:local_raw_material_output
	owner = { add = modifier:global_raw_material_output }
	if = {
		limit = { raw_material = goods:wheat }
		add = modifier:local_wheat_output_modifier
		owner = { add = modifier:global_wheat_output_modifier }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { raw_material = goods:rice }
		add = modifier:local_rice_output_modifier
		owner = { add = modifier:global_rice_output_modifier }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { raw_material = goods:millet }
		add = modifier:local_millet_output_modifier
		owner = { add = modifier:global_millet_output_modifier }
	}
	min = 0
}
eu5ab_windmill_added_revenue = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_rgo_revenue eu5ab_windmill_output_factor > 0 }
		value = scope:eu5ab_engine_rgo_revenue
		divide = eu5ab_windmill_output_factor
		multiply = 0.1
		min = 0
	}
}
# Location scope, including non-capitals: base decay comes from the province
# capital and its owner, while preservation includes every location in the province.
eu5ab_province_food_decay_base = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { exists = province.capital exists = province.capital.owner }
		province.capital = {
			value = modifier:local_food_decay
			owner = { add = modifier:global_food_decay }
		}
	}
	min = 0
}
eu5ab_province_food_preservation = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { exists = province }
		province = { every_location_in_province = {
			add = modifier:local_food_preservation_efficiency_modifier
		} }
	}
}
# Fixed-point division precedes multiplication, preserving the native rate/loss
# truncation. Current stock is identical on both sides; new capacity is not food.
eu5ab_province_monthly_food_decay = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { exists = province eu5ab_province_food_preservation >= 0 }
		value = eu5ab_province_food_decay_base
		divide = { value = eu5ab_province_food_preservation add = 1 }
		multiply = { value = province.province_food min = 0 }
	}
}
eu5ab_province_monthly_food_decay_after_granary = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { exists = province eu5ab_province_food_preservation >= 0 }
		value = eu5ab_province_food_decay_base
		divide = { value = eu5ab_province_food_preservation add = 1.05 }
		multiply = { value = province.province_food min = 0 }
	}
}
eu5ab_granary_monthly_food_saved = {
	value = eu5ab_province_monthly_food_decay
	subtract = eu5ab_province_monthly_food_decay_after_granary
	min = 0
}
# Native recipe profit already subtracts operation costs. Add indirect value exactly once.
# Food savings are an opportunity value, never reported as tax income.
eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit = { value = 0
        if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_type
            var:eu5ab_quote_production_type = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
            has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_adjusted_profit_ready } }
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_adjusted_profit }
                add = var:eu5ab_quote_production_adjusted_profit } }
        }
        else = { value = eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit_live }
    }

eu5ab_market_glass_projected_construction_overage = {
	value = "market.goods_demand_in_market(goods:glass)"
	market = { save_temporary_scope_as = eu5ab_material_market }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable_map = eu5ab_q_market_committed_glass
			is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_q_market_committed_glass target = scope:eu5ab_material_market }
		}
		add = "global_variable_map(eu5ab_q_market_committed_glass|scope:eu5ab_material_market)"
	}
	add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_construction_demand_glass
	subtract = {
		value = "market.goods_supply_in_market(goods:glass)"
		multiply = eu5ab_construction_shortage_factor
	}
}

eu5ab_market_lumber_projected_construction_overage = {
	value = "market.goods_demand_in_market(goods:lumber)"
	market = { save_temporary_scope_as = eu5ab_material_market }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable_map = eu5ab_q_market_committed_lumber
			is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_q_market_committed_lumber target = scope:eu5ab_material_market }
		}
		add = "global_variable_map(eu5ab_q_market_committed_lumber|scope:eu5ab_material_market)"
	}
	add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_construction_demand_lumber
	subtract = {
		value = "market.goods_supply_in_market(goods:lumber)"
		multiply = eu5ab_construction_shortage_factor
	}
}

eu5ab_market_masonry_projected_construction_overage = {
	value = "market.goods_demand_in_market(goods:masonry)"
	market = { save_temporary_scope_as = eu5ab_material_market }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable_map = eu5ab_q_market_committed_masonry
			is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_q_market_committed_masonry target = scope:eu5ab_material_market }
		}
		add = "global_variable_map(eu5ab_q_market_committed_masonry|scope:eu5ab_material_market)"
	}
	add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_construction_demand_masonry
	subtract = {
		value = "market.goods_supply_in_market(goods:masonry)"
		multiply = eu5ab_construction_shortage_factor
	}
}

		add = 1
	}

	market = { save_temporary_scope_as = eu5ab_material_market }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable_map = eu5ab_q_market_committed_weaponry

	subtract = {
		value = "market.goods_supply_in_market(goods:weaponry)"

	}

# Province-native raw-input fit is a recipe-consistent proxy, not the exact
# Building.GetBuildingProductionEfficiency C++ value.
eu5ab_native_input_coverage_percent = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_recipe_expected_raw_total > 0 }
		value = eu5ab_recipe_expected_raw_matched
		divide = eu5ab_recipe_expected_raw_total
		multiply = 100
	}
}

eu5ab_native_input_fit_unscaled = {
	value = eu5ab_native_input_coverage_percent
	divide = 100
	multiply = 500
}

eu5ab_native_input_shortage_factor = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_candidate_scoring_input_shortage = yes }
		multiply = 0.5
	}
}

eu5ab_current_native_input_priority = {
	value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_native_input_priority
}

eu5ab_native_input_fit_proxy_score = {
	value = 0
	# A disabled preference needs neither province matching nor shortage queries.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_current_native_input_priority = 0 } }
		value = eu5ab_native_input_fit_unscaled
		multiply = eu5ab_current_native_input_priority
		divide = 10
		multiply = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market_access
		multiply = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.local_control
		multiply = eu5ab_native_input_shortage_factor
	}
}

	value = 0
	if = {

	min = 0
	max = 500
}

	value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_price_min
	divide = 100
}

	value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_price_max
	divide = 100

eu5ab_universal_need_score = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { has_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_building var:eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_building = prev has_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_need_score_ready } }
		if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { has_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_need_score } } add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_need_score }
	}
	else = {
		if = {

eu5ab_typed_need_score_academy_of_sciences = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_candidate_scoring_input_shortage = yes }
		add = -3000
	}
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_candidate_replaces_existing_building = yes }
		add = 5000
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_replaces_existing_building = yes } }
		add = {
			value = "scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.location_building_level(building_type:academy_of_sciences)"
			multiply = 1
		}
	}
}

				market_food_percentage <= 0.25
			}

				market_food_percentage <= 0.5

		}
		add = 4500
	}
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_candidate_scoring_input_shortage = yes }
		add = -3000
	}
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_candidate_replaces_existing_building = yes }

				"goods_supply_in_market(goods:naval_supplies)" < {
					value = "goods_demand_in_market(goods:naval_supplies)"
					multiply = 0.65
				}

		}
		add = 3500
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {

				"goods_supply_in_market(goods:naval_supplies)" < {
					value = "goods_demand_in_market(goods:naval_supplies)"
					multiply = 0.9
				}
			}

			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner = { at_war = yes }
			OR = { eu5ab_recipe_naval_supplies_guild_0_selected = 1 }
		}
		add = 1800
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					OR = {
						eu5ab_recipe_naval_supplies_guild_0_selected = 1
					}
					OR = {
						scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market ?= {
							"goods_supply_in_market(goods:naval_supplies)" < {
								value = "goods_demand_in_market(goods:naval_supplies)"
								multiply = 0.9
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add = 3200
	}
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_candidate_scoring_input_shortage = yes }
		add = -3000
	}
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_candidate_replaces_existing_building = yes }

# Current RGO utilization is workers divided by built capacity, not by
# the location's theoretical geological maximum.
eu5ab_rgo_current_capacity = {
	value = rgo_level
	multiply = eu5ab_rgo_jobs_per_expansion
}

eu5ab_rgo_utilization_ratio = {
	value = rgo_workers
	divide = { value = eu5ab_rgo_current_capacity min = 0.001 }
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

			OR = {
				AND = {
					owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_emergency_food_exhaustion_override > 0
					market ?= { is_projected_to_run_out_of_food_stockpile = yes }
				}
				AND = {
					owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_emergency_food_stockpile_override > 0
					market ?= { market_food_percentage <= 0.25 }
				}
			}
		}
		add = 2000
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			raw_material = goods:wild_game
			OR = {
				AND = {
					owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_emergency_food_exhaustion_override > 0
					market ?= { is_projected_to_run_out_of_food_stockpile = yes }
				}
				AND = {
					owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_emergency_food_stockpile_override > 0
					market ?= { market_food_percentage <= 0.25 }
				}
			}
		}
		add = 2000
	}
}

# Cross-feature priority comes from the ordered CMM list. This score only
# combines general location need with RGO-specific need inside the RGO class.
eu5ab_rgo_base_score_screen_live = {
	value = eu5ab_location_need_score
	# RGO does not inherit the ordinary-building recent-start penalty.
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty }
		subtract = -160
	}
	add = eu5ab_rgo_candidate_score
}

eu5ab_rgo_queue_order_score = {
	value = eu5ab_rgo_base_score
	multiply = eu5ab_rgo_price_factor
	multiply = eu5ab_rgo_pending_factor
	multiply = eu5ab_rgo_current_labor_factor
}

eu5ab_rgo_high_price_factor = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { eu5ab_rgo_price_percent > 100 }
        if = {
            limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_price_max > 100 }
            value = eu5ab_rgo_price_percent
            subtract = 100
            divide = { value = owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_price_max subtract = 100 }
            max = 1
        }
        else = { value = 1 }
    }
}
eu5ab_rgo_price_factor = {
    value = 1
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { eu5ab_rgo_price_percent <= owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_price_min }
            value = 0
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_price_min < 100 eu5ab_rgo_price_percent < 100 }
            value = eu5ab_rgo_price_percent
            subtract = owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_price_min
            divide = { value = 100 subtract = owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_price_min }
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_rgo_current_labor_factor = {
    value = 1
    if = {
        limit = {
            owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_pause_low_workforce <= 0
            eu5ab_rgo_current_available_workers < eu5ab_rgo_jobs_per_expansion
        }
        value = 0.4
    }
}
eu5ab_candidate_current_labor_factor_live = { value = 1
        if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_labor_factor trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_labor_factor } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_batch_labor_factor target = prev } } } } }
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_labor_factor|prev)" } }
        else = { value = eu5ab_candidate_current_labor_factor_live_uncached }
    }

                owner = { add = "variable_map(eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown_wine|prev.market)" }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { raw_material = goods:wool }
            if = { limit = { owner = { AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown_wool trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown_wool } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown_wool target = prev.market } } } } }
                owner = { add = "variable_map(eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown_wool|prev.market)" }
            }
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_rgo_market_gap_screen_live = {
    value = eu5ab_rgo_market_demand
    subtract = eu5ab_rgo_market_supply
    min = 0
}
eu5ab_rgo_pending_limit_screen_live = {
    value = eu5ab_rgo_market_demand
    min = 0
    multiply = 0.1
    add = eu5ab_rgo_market_gap
}
eu5ab_rgo_pending_factor = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } value = 1 }
    else_if = {
        limit = { eu5ab_rgo_pending_data_available = yes eu5ab_rgo_pending_below_limit = yes }
        value = 1
        if = {
            limit = { eu5ab_rgo_market_pending_quantity > 0 eu5ab_rgo_pending_limit > 0 }
            subtract = {
                value = eu5ab_rgo_market_pending_quantity
                divide = eu5ab_rgo_pending_limit
                multiply = { value = eu5ab_rgo_market_pending_quantity divide = eu5ab_rgo_pending_limit }
            }
            # Keep a positive factor below the stop, even at fixed-point resolution.
            min = 0.00001
        }
    }
}

# The pre-start value is read only after full existing staffing has passed.
eu5ab_rgo_full_level_output = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { rgo_level > 0 raw_material_output > 0 eu5ab_rgo_utilization_allowed = yes }
        value = raw_material_output
        divide = rgo_level
    }
}
eu5ab_rgo_staffed_levels = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { eu5ab_rgo_jobs_per_expansion > 0 rgo_workers >= 0 rgo_level >= 0 }
        value = rgo_workers
        divide = eu5ab_rgo_jobs_per_expansion
        floor = yes
        min = 0
        max = rgo_level
    }
}

eu5ab_current_min_cash_reserve = {
	value = owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_min_cash_reserve
}


# Zero variables may disappear in EU5; readiness is independent of the value.
eu5ab_rgo_queue_count_value = { value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_count } add = var:eu5ab_rgo_queue_count }
}
eu5ab_rgo_queue_level_value = { value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_level } add = var:eu5ab_rgo_queue_level }
}
# Timed-variable days accepts a named script value, not a direct var: target.
eu5ab_rgo_pending_wait_days = {
    value = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_build_days
}
eu5ab_rgos_under_construction = {
    value = -1
    if = { limit = { num_civil_constructions = 0 } value = 0 }
    else_if = { limit = { eu5ab_rgo_queue_current = yes } value = eu5ab_rgo_queue_count_value }
}
# Workforce reservations may use a conservative bound while awaiting a read.
# This bound is never used for project identity, cancellation or output release.
eu5ab_rgo_queued_jobs = {
    value = eu5ab_rgos_under_construction
    if = { limit = { eu5ab_rgos_under_construction < 0 } value = num_civil_constructions }
    multiply = eu5ab_rgo_jobs_per_expansion
}


# Preflight estimate, not an engine quote. Source: src/eu5autobuild/rgo_cost.py.
# Location scope. The batch screener caches this estimate; no location/goods iteration.
eu5ab_rgo_category_cost_multiplier = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { raw_material = { goods_method = mining } }
		add = owner.modifier:expand_rgo_mining_cost_modifier
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { raw_material = { goods_method = farming } }
		add = owner.modifier:expand_rgo_farming_cost_modifier
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { raw_material = { goods_method = hunting } }
		add = owner.modifier:expand_rgo_hunting_cost_modifier
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { raw_material = { goods_method = gathering } }
		add = owner.modifier:expand_rgo_gathering_cost_modifier
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { raw_material = { goods_method = forestry } }
		add = owner.modifier:expand_rgo_forestry_cost_modifier
	}
}

eu5ab_rgo_material_price_ratio = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = market }
		if = {
			limit = { raw_material = { goods_method = forestry } }
			value = "market.market_price(goods:masonry)"
			divide = "default_price(goods:masonry)"
		}
		else = {
			value = "market.market_price(goods:lumber)"
			divide = "default_price(goods:lumber)"
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_rgo_material_cost_multiplier = {
	value = eu5ab_rgo_material_price_ratio
	subtract = 1
	# Provisional price curve; bounds are native NMarket defines.
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_rgo_material_price_ratio < 1 }
		multiply = 10
		divide = 9
	}
	else = { divide = 2 }
	min = "define:NMarket|MIN_PRICE_IMPACT"
	max = "define:NMarket|MAX_PRICE_IMPACT"
	add = 1
}

eu5ab_rgo_expansion_cost = {
	# Multiplication order reproduces the SWE 75.43575 calibration case
	# under five-decimal fixed-point arithmetic; not proof for all cases.
	value = 1
	add = owner.inflation
	multiply = eu5ab_rgo_material_cost_multiplier
	multiply = 100
	multiply = {
		value = "default_price(raw_material)"
		multiply = "define:NEconomy|GOODS_RGO_PRICE_SCALE"
		add = "define:NEconomy|GOODS_RGO_BASE_COST"
	}
	multiply = eu5ab_rgo_category_cost_multiplier
}

eu5ab_rgo_cash_required = {
	value = eu5ab_rgo_expansion_cost
	add = eu5ab_current_min_cash_reserve
}

eu5ab_output_alum_low = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { eu5ab_output_alum_valid = yes eu5ab_market_price_alum > { value = "default_price(goods:alum)" multiply = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_price_min divide = 100 } }
        value = 1
        if = {
            limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_price_min < 100 eu5ab_market_price_alum < "default_price(goods:alum)" }
            value = eu5ab_market_price_alum
            subtract = { value = "default_price(goods:alum)" multiply = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_price_min divide = 100 }
            divide = { value = "default_price(goods:alum)" multiply = { value = 100 subtract = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_price_min } divide = 100 min = 0.00001 }
            min = 0.00001
            max = 1
        }
    }
}

    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { eu5ab_output_price_data_valid = yes }
        value = 1
        if = {
            limit = { eu5ab_output_weight > 0 NOT = { AND = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { eu5ab_food_emergency_enabled = yes } eu5ab_candidate_produces_food = yes } } }
            value = 0
            if = {
                limit = { eu5ab_output_low_weight > 0 }
                value = eu5ab_output_low_weight
                divide = eu5ab_output_weight
                min = 0.00001
                max = 1
            }
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_price_adjusted_candidate_score_live = {
	value = eu5ab_unadjusted_candidate_score
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_output_price_factor > 0 }
		if = { limit = { eu5ab_unadjusted_candidate_score >= 0 } multiply = eu5ab_output_price_factor }
		else_if = { limit = { eu5ab_unadjusted_candidate_score < -90000000000000 } value = eu5ab_unadjusted_candidate_score }
		else_if = { limit = { eu5ab_unadjusted_candidate_score < { value = -90000000000000 multiply = eu5ab_output_price_factor } } value = -90000000000000 }
		else = { divide = eu5ab_output_price_factor }
	}
	else = { value = 0 }
}

	value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value

		limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_output_price_factor > 0 }
		if = { limit = { eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value >= 0 } multiply = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_output_price_factor }
		else_if = { limit = { eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value < -90000000000000 } value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value }
		else_if = { limit = { eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value < { value = -90000000000000 multiply = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_output_price_factor } } value = -90000000000000 }
		else = { divide = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_output_price_factor }
	}
	else = { value = 0 }
}

		limit = { eu5ab_candidate_capacity_factor > 0 }
		if = { limit = { eu5ab_pending_adjusted_candidate_score >= 0 } multiply = eu5ab_candidate_capacity_factor }
		else_if = { limit = { eu5ab_pending_adjusted_candidate_score < -90000000000000 } value = eu5ab_pending_adjusted_candidate_score }
		else_if = { limit = { eu5ab_pending_adjusted_candidate_score < { value = -90000000000000 multiply = eu5ab_candidate_capacity_factor } } value = -90000000000000 }
		else = { divide = eu5ab_candidate_capacity_factor }
	}
	else = { value = 0 }
}

eu5ab_candidate_input_unit_books = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_pending_identity_known = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_quote_production_current = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_input_ready
                    }
                }
                value = {
                    value = 0
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        add = {
                            value = 0
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                        name = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input
                                        target = goods:books
                                    } } }
                                }
                                add = "variable_map(eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input|goods:books)"
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            else = {
                value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building.eu5ab_pr_nominal_input_books_validated
                multiply = {
                    value = 0
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                                has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                            }
                        }
                        add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building.eu5ab_pr_reference_input_books
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_market_pending_factor_books = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_market_pending_known_books = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_market_pending_books <= 0
            }
            value = 1
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_market_pending_limit_books > 0
                eu5ab_market_pending_books < eu5ab_market_pending_limit_books
            }
            value = 1
            subtract = {
                value = eu5ab_market_pending_books
                divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_books
                multiply = {
                    value = eu5ab_market_pending_books
                    divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_books
                }
            }
            min = 0.00001
        }
    }

eu5ab_candidate_input_unit_cannons = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_pending_identity_known = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_quote_production_current = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_input_ready
                    }
                }
                value = {
                    value = 0
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        add = {
                            value = 0
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                        name = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input
                                        target = goods:cannons
                                    } } }
                                }
                                add = "variable_map(eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input|goods:cannons)"
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            else = {
                value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building.eu5ab_pr_nominal_input_cannons_validated
                multiply = {
                    value = 0
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                                has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                            }
                        }
                        add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building.eu5ab_pr_reference_input_cannons
        }
    }
}

                    name = eu5ab_build_future_input_cannons
                    target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market
                } } }
            }
            add = "variable_map(eu5ab_build_future_input_cannons|scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market)"
        }
    }

    subtract = eu5ab_market_pending_cannons
    min = 0

eu5ab_market_pending_factor_cannons = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_market_pending_known_cannons = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_market_pending_cannons <= 0
            }
            value = 1
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_market_pending_limit_cannons > 0
                eu5ab_market_pending_cannons < eu5ab_market_pending_limit_cannons
            }
            value = 1
            subtract = {
                value = eu5ab_market_pending_cannons
                divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_cannons
                multiply = {
                    value = eu5ab_market_pending_cannons
                    divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_cannons
                }
            }
            min = 0.00001
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_market_pending_factor_clay = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_market_pending_known_clay = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_market_pending_clay <= 0
            }
            value = 1
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_market_pending_limit_clay > 0
                eu5ab_market_pending_clay < eu5ab_market_pending_limit_clay
            }
            value = 1
            subtract = {
                value = eu5ab_market_pending_clay
                divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_clay
                multiply = {
                    value = eu5ab_market_pending_clay
                    divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_clay
                }
            }
            min = 0.00001
        }
    }

        limit = {
            eu5ab_pending_identity_known = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {

            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_output_ready
                    }
                }
                value = {
                    value = 0
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        add = {
                            value = 0
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_output trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_output } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                        name = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_output
                                        target = goods:cloth
                                    } } }
                                }
                                add = "variable_map(eu5ab_quote_production_reference_output|goods:cloth)"
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            else = {
                value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building.eu5ab_pr_nominal_output_cloth_validated
                multiply = {
                    value = 0
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                                has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                            }
                        }
                        add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building.eu5ab_pr_reference_output_cloth
        }
    }

eu5ab_market_pending_factor_fine_cloth = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_market_pending_known_fine_cloth = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_market_pending_fine_cloth <= 0
            }
            value = 1
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_market_pending_limit_fine_cloth > 0
                eu5ab_market_pending_fine_cloth < eu5ab_market_pending_limit_fine_cloth
            }
            value = 1
            subtract = {
                value = eu5ab_market_pending_fine_cloth
                divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_fine_cloth
                multiply = {
                    value = eu5ab_market_pending_fine_cloth
                    divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_fine_cloth
                }
            }
            min = 0.00001
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_candidate_input_unit_firearms = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_pending_identity_known = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_quote_production_current = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_input_ready
                    }
                }
                value = {
                    value = 0
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        add = {
                            value = 0
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                        name = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input
                                        target = goods:firearms
                                    } } }
                                }
                                add = "variable_map(eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input|goods:firearms)"
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            else = {
                value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building.eu5ab_pr_nominal_input_firearms_validated
                multiply = {
                    value = 0
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                                has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                            }
                        }
                        add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building.eu5ab_pr_reference_input_firearms
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_market_pending_factor_firearms = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_market_pending_known_firearms = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_market_pending_firearms <= 0
            }
            value = 1
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_market_pending_limit_firearms > 0
                eu5ab_market_pending_firearms < eu5ab_market_pending_limit_firearms
            }
            value = 1
            subtract = {
                value = eu5ab_market_pending_firearms
                divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_firearms
                multiply = {
                    value = eu5ab_market_pending_firearms
                    divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_firearms
                }
            }
            min = 0.00001
        }
    }

eu5ab_candidate_input_unit_lumber = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_pending_identity_known = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_quote_production_current = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_input_ready
                    }
                }
                value = {
                    value = 0
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        add = {
                            value = 0
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                        name = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input
                                        target = goods:lumber
                                    } } }
                                }
                                add = "variable_map(eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input|goods:lumber)"
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            else = {
                value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building.eu5ab_pr_nominal_input_lumber_validated
                multiply = {
                    value = 0
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                                has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                            }
                        }
                        add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building.eu5ab_pr_reference_input_lumber
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_candidate_old_input_lumber = { value = 0

            }
            value = 1
            subtract = {
                value = eu5ab_market_pending_masonry
                divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_masonry
                multiply = {
                    value = eu5ab_market_pending_masonry
                    divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_masonry
                }
            }
            min = 0.00001
        }
    }

eu5ab_candidate_input_unit_paper = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_pending_identity_known = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_quote_production_current = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_input_ready
                    }
                }
                value = {
                    value = 0
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        add = {
                            value = 0
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                        name = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input
                                        target = goods:paper
                                    } } }
                                }
                                add = "variable_map(eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input|goods:paper)"
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            else = {
                value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building.eu5ab_pr_nominal_input_paper_validated
                multiply = {
                    value = 0
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                                has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                            }
                        }
                        add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building.eu5ab_pr_reference_input_paper
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_candidate_old_input_paper = { value = 0
                if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_quote_restored } }
                    value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_old_input_paper }
                else = { value = eu5ab_candidate_old_input_paper_live }
            }

eu5ab_candidate_net_input_paper = { value = 0
                if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_quote_restored } }
                    value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_net_input_paper }
                else = { value = eu5ab_candidate_net_input_paper_live }
            }

eu5ab_market_future_input_paper = {
    value = 0
    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_build_future_input_paper trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_build_future_input_paper } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                    name = eu5ab_build_future_input_paper
                    target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market
                } } }
            }
            add = "variable_map(eu5ab_build_future_input_paper|scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market)"
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_market_effective_demand_paper = { value = 0
                if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_quote_restored } } value = eu5ab_market_effective_demand_paper_snapshot }
                else = { value = eu5ab_market_effective_demand_paper_live }
            }

                else = { value = eu5ab_market_pending_paper_live }

eu5ab_market_uncovered_paper = {
    value = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_paper
    subtract = eu5ab_market_pending_paper
    min = 0
}
eu5ab_market_pending_factor_paper = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_market_pending_known_paper = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_market_pending_paper <= 0
            }
            value = 1
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_market_pending_limit_paper > 0
                eu5ab_market_pending_paper < eu5ab_market_pending_limit_paper
            }
            value = 1
            subtract = {
                value = eu5ab_market_pending_paper
                divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_paper
                multiply = {
                    value = eu5ab_market_pending_paper
                    divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_paper
                }
            }
            min = 0.00001
        }
    }
}

            }
            value = 1
        }

                eu5ab_market_pending_rice < eu5ab_market_pending_limit_rice
            }
            value = 1
            subtract = {
                value = eu5ab_market_pending_rice
                divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_rice
                multiply = {
                    value = eu5ab_market_pending_rice
                    divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_rice
                }
            }
            min = 0.00001
        }
    }

                    divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_tar

eu5ab_candidate_input_unit_tools = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_pending_identity_known = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_quote_production_current = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_input_ready
                    }
                }
                value = {
                    value = 0
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        add = {
                            value = 0
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                        name = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input
                                        target = goods:tools
                                    } } }
                                }
                                add = "variable_map(eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input|goods:tools)"
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            else = {
                value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building.eu5ab_pr_nominal_input_tools_validated
                multiply = {
                    value = 0
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                                has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                            }
                        }
                        add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building.eu5ab_pr_reference_input_tools
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_market_uncovered_tools = {
    value = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_tools
    subtract = eu5ab_market_pending_tools
    min = 0
}
eu5ab_market_pending_factor_tools = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_market_pending_known_tools = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_market_pending_tools <= 0
            }
            value = 1
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_market_pending_limit_tools > 0
                eu5ab_market_pending_tools < eu5ab_market_pending_limit_tools
            }
            value = 1
            subtract = {
                value = eu5ab_market_pending_tools
                divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_tools
                multiply = {
                    value = eu5ab_market_pending_tools
                    divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_tools
                }
            }
            min = 0.00001
        }
    }
}

            else = {

                multiply = {

                    }
                }
            }
        }

        }
    }

                value = eu5ab_market_pending_weaponry

                    value = eu5ab_market_pending_weaponry
                    divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_weaponry

        }
    }

eu5ab_candidate_input_unit_wool = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_pending_identity_known = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_quote_production_current = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_input_ready
                    }
                }
                value = {
                    value = 0
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        add = {
                            value = 0
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                        name = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input
                                        target = goods:wool
                                    } } }
                                }
                                add = "variable_map(eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input|goods:wool)"
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            else = {
                value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building.eu5ab_pr_nominal_input_wool_validated
                multiply = {
                    value = 0
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                                has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                            }
                        }
                        add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building.eu5ab_pr_reference_input_wool
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_market_pending_factor_wool = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_market_pending_known_wool = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_market_pending_wool <= 0
            }
            value = 1
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_market_pending_limit_wool > 0
                eu5ab_market_pending_wool < eu5ab_market_pending_limit_wool
            }
            value = 1
            subtract = {
                value = eu5ab_market_pending_wool
                divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_wool
                multiply = {
                    value = eu5ab_market_pending_wool
                    divide = eu5ab_market_pending_limit_wool
                }
            }
            min = 0.00001
        }
    }

                multiply = "default_price(goods:weaponry)"
                multiply = eu5ab_market_pending_factor_weaponry
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            this = building_type:weapon_manufactory
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_candidate_net_output_weaponry > 0
            }
            add = {
                value = eu5ab_candidate_net_output_weaponry
                multiply = "default_price(goods:weaponry)"
                multiply = eu5ab_market_pending_factor_weaponry
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            this = building_type:weapon_workshop
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_candidate_net_output_weaponry > 0
            }
            add = {
                value = eu5ab_candidate_net_output_weaponry
                multiply = "default_price(goods:weaponry)"
                multiply = eu5ab_market_pending_factor_weaponry
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            this = building_type:winery
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_candidate_net_output_wine > 0
            }
            add = {
                value = eu5ab_candidate_net_output_wine
                multiply = "default_price(goods:wine)"
                multiply = eu5ab_market_pending_factor_wine
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            this = building_type:winery_manufactory
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_candidate_net_output_wine > 0
            }
            add = {
                value = eu5ab_candidate_net_output_wine
                multiply = "default_price(goods:wine)"
                multiply = eu5ab_market_pending_factor_wine
            }
        }
    }

eu5ab_candidate_pending_factor_live = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_candidate_pending_allowed = yes
        }
        value = 1
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_pending_weight > 0
                NOT = {
                    AND = {
                        scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                            eu5ab_food_emergency_enabled = yes
                        }
                        eu5ab_candidate_produces_food = yes
                    }
                }
            }
            value = eu5ab_pending_weighted
            divide = eu5ab_pending_weight
            min = 0.00001
            max = 1
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_candidate_pending_preliminary_factor_live = {
    value = eu5ab_candidate_pending_factor
}
eu5ab_pending_adjusted_candidate_score_live = {
    value = eu5ab_price_adjusted_candidate_score
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_candidate_pending_preliminary_factor > 0
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_price_adjusted_candidate_score >= 0
            }
            multiply = eu5ab_candidate_pending_preliminary_factor
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_price_adjusted_candidate_score < -90000000000000
            }
            value = eu5ab_price_adjusted_candidate_score
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_price_adjusted_candidate_score < {
                    value = -90000000000000
                    multiply = eu5ab_candidate_pending_preliminary_factor
                }
            }
            value = -90000000000000
        }
        else = {
            divide = eu5ab_candidate_pending_preliminary_factor
        }
    }
    else = {
        value = 0
    }
}
eu5ab_pending_profit_rank = {
    value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value
    if = {
        limit = {
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_pending_factor > 0
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value >= 0
            }
            multiply = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_pending_factor
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value < -90000000000000
            }
            value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value < {
                    value = -90000000000000
                    multiply = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_pending_factor
                }
            }
            value = -90000000000000
        }
        else = {
            divide = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_pending_factor
        }
    }
    else = {
        value = 0
    }
}

eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit_live = {
	value = scope:eu5ab_engine_profit
	if = {
		limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { this = building_type:windmill } }
		add = eu5ab_windmill_added_revenue
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_is_granary = yes } eu5ab_location_food_price_known = yes }
		add = { value = eu5ab_granary_monthly_food_saved multiply = eu5ab_location_food_price }
	}
}

    }

eu5ab_candidate_net_output_alum_live = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_quote_production_current = yes
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_output_ready
            }
        }
        value = {
            value = 0
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                add = {
                    value = 0
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_net_output trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_net_output } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                name = eu5ab_quote_production_net_output
                                target = goods:alum
                            } } }
                        }
                        add = "variable_map(eu5ab_quote_production_net_output|goods:alum)"
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        value = eu5ab_candidate_output_unit_alum
        subtract = eu5ab_candidate_old_output_alum
        min = 0
    }
}
